about.title: About Us
about.content:
Welcome to our studio! We are dedicated to providing exceptional training experiences in a supportive and welcoming environment.

## Our Mission
Our mission is to help you achieve your fitness and wellness goals through expert instruction, personalized attention, and a community-focused approach.

## Our Instructors
All our instructors are certified professionals with years of experience. They are passionate about helping students grow and improve their practice.

## Our Facilities
We offer state-of-the-art facilities designed to enhance your learning experience. Our studio is equipped with modern equipment and comfortable spaces for all types of classes.

## Join Us
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced practitioner, we welcome you to join our community. Book a trial lesson today and experience what makes us special!

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.content:
By using our services, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

## Registration and Payment
- All class bookings require advance registration
- Payment must be completed before attending classes
- Token packages are non-refundable but may be transferable

## Cancellation Policy
- Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance
- Late cancellations may result in token deduction
- No-shows will be charged the full class fee

## Class Attendance
- Please arrive on time for your scheduled class
- Late arrivals may not be admitted
- Respectful behavior is expected at all times

## Liability
- Participants engage in classes at their own risk
- Please inform instructors of any injuries or medical conditions
- We are not liable for any injuries sustained during classes

## Changes to Terms
We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of any changes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our services.

## Information We Collect
We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
- Name and contact information
- Payment information
- Class preferences and enrollment history

## How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect to:
- Process your registrations and payments
- Communicate with you about classes and services
- Improve our services and user experience

## Data Security
We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

## Contact Us
If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at info@studio.com.
